source_decisions.original_headline: Flow Power begins 223 MWh Australian battery, plans 1.2 GWh expansion
source_decisions.reason: September14 was a ceremony at an already-started 100MW/223MWh construction site (Flow Power May14 already said work commenced; Dec2025 financial close); Sept18 also announced up-to-300MW/1.2GWh Stage2 only at preliminary environmental/planning phase. Live company project page currently says 100MW/233MWh versus dated Sept18 223MWh: unresolved owner version difference.
source_decisions.future_trigger: Stage2 development approval application filed/approved, new financial close or signed EPC, Stage1 final authoritative engineering MWh, actual 2028 COD.

source_decisions.original_headline: UK regulator plans BESS fees to cut grid connection queue
source_decisions.must_not_claim: Do not claim £3,000/MW or £25,000/MW fee is already levied, approved, collected, universally applies, or that 90GW are all queued/unbuilt. Around 90GW includes about 83GW shortlisted and 7GW already operational; 29GW is a 2035 need projection.

90GW储能排队，英国为什么开始收“占位费”？
China TOPCon solar cell prices fall for third week as export buying fades and wafer costs ease
source_decisions.reason: PV magazine reports OPIS September15 solar TOPCon photovoltaic cell price M10 FOB $0.0469/W and 210R $0.0458/W. This is a time-specific proprietary PV price assessment, not a lithium-ion ESS battery-cell USD/Wh benchmark, independently verified shipment price or new corporate economic act.
source_decisions.future_trigger: Official OPIS comparable period-by-period methodology and demonstrated separate ESS/PV hybrid procurement price pass-through.

source_decisions.original_headline: Tribunal Terminates Expiry Review—Photovoltaic Modules and Laminates from China
source_decisions.must_not_claim: Do not extend this PV-specific rescission to lithium battery cells, inverters or complete ESS; do not claim all Canadian import tariffs disappeared, pre-March25 releases qualify for refunds or retroactive repayment was already fully disbursed.

source_decisions.original_headline: LG전자, 'AI 데이터센터' 특화 터보 칠러 출시…“전력 소비량 30% 절감”
source_decisions.reason: LG stated the turbo chiller was released on September20; owner newsroom posted September21. Four original media articles describe one AI-data-centre cooling appliance release, not ESS procurement. Manufacturer's conditional around-30% annual chiller electricity saving compares water versus refrigerant free cooling; no independently measured site PUE, battery dispatch, sales booking or new datacentre BESS.
source_decisions.future_trigger: Independent operating annual cooling kWh validation and signed data-centre deployments materially linking battery or grid demand.
